basis: Case-specific RxR Core lessons, 33 authored local coverage rows, and source-preserving positive/diagnostic calibration. Measured by deterministic compilation in the recorded source run; all new behavioral tests and R2R isolation passed before reviewing these changed expectations. Common contract, schemas, compiler and R2R inputs remain frozen. CI never rewrites these expectations.
recheck_contract: With the same frozen selection, Reviewer review and recheck compile the same system contract and response schema. Recheck-specific candidate and prior-review content is carried by the existing user payload, not by editing the frozen examples.
